card.name: Small joiners before a medical term
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas and the word "with" that sit right before a section number, a symptom or a named condition in drug-label text. Examples are "Table 7", "headache, papilledema" and "patients with RA".

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a table or section number in a cross-reference.

modes.label: "with" before a condition
modes.description: The word "with" after patients, leading into a disease name.
modes.example: In two studies of patients<< with>> RA with an increased risk of venous

modes.label: Comma in a symptom list
modes.description: A comma after a symptom such as headache, before the next symptom.
modes.example: including headache<<,>> papilledema, blurred vision, dip
